user.title: Set up beste.schule
user.description:
You need a Personal Access Token from your beste.schule user account.

How to get it:
1. Sign in to beste.schule.
2. Open your user account from your name in the top right.
3. Select API in the left menu.
4. Create a new token under Personal Access Token.
5. Copy the token and paste it here.

data_description.token: The token from the API section in your beste.schule user account.

error.cannot_connect: The API could not be reached or checked reliably. Please check your internet connection.
error.invalid_auth: beste.schule rejected the token. Please create a new Personal Access Token and paste it completely.
